body:
FOLR direction discussion: decide whether an explicitly public-lifecycle version of CAMA Traffic Junction warrants one bounded real learned RETAIN-versus-RESET comparison, or preserve the present no-successor boundary.

P77 found a concrete source-interface mismatch: native removal and same-step slot refill can hide a new physical car behind an unchanged mask, while the source controller carries slot memory through inactivity. This issue does not override that finding or treat hidden callbacks as already permitted.

The proposed variant keeps native traffic transitions and reward but openly changes its information protocol. Both arms would receive the same trip-aware state bookkeeping, and both learned actors would receive a global membership-change bit and their own birth bit. New cars start fresh in both; RETAIN keeps true survivors' recurrent history, RESET clears it at actual membership events. A RESET loss would establish only bounded erasure cost, never typed-state novelty or original-task necessity.

Fixed evidence at 64db6307b236ffaa98e61f4ea83a5cdbb0a20bfb:
- [P77 source-interface intake](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/64db6307b236ffaa98e61f4ea83a5cdbb0a20bfb/docs/research/candidates/vap_folr_core/FOLR_P77_CAMA_SURVIVOR_SOURCE_INTAKE_20260909.md)
- [Verified source facts and work counts](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/64db6307b236ffaa98e61f4ea83a5cdbb0a20bfb/docs/research/candidates/vap_folr_core/evidence/2026-09-09-p77-cama-survivor-source.json)

Known unallocated scale: two arms, one matched training instance, 201280 total native ticks, 9938 RMSprop steps, 66783360 online/target replay GRU row forwards. Wall cost is unknown. Exact card, configuration and invocation budget remain unallocated; no diagnostic prerequisite is proposed.

Current state: question preparation only. The DM recommends the explicit extension narrowly, as a close call. The strong zero-work alternative is ordinary generic RETAIN without another family or claim. The original Convergence node selects scope; Root owns dispatch and any later allocation. No provider Send, model, simulator, implementation or new card has occurred.

The complete answer will be delivered only to `docs/research/candidates/vap_folr_core/pro_packets/20260909_p78_public_lifecycle_convergence/archive/RESPONSE.md` on the existing shared `codex/vap-folr` branch, with its immutable delivery link in this issue.

Published fixed task: [Read the full Convergence question](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/83f7beafd632bd7e54a6c6ad3e47044357284189/docs/research/candidates/vap_folr_core/pro_packets/20260909_p78_public_lifecycle_convergence/TASK.md).
title: FOLR: public lifecycle information for survivor-memory comparison
